findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The coolers containing milk, dips, and creamer are observed to have an accumulation of mold on the shelves as well as some areas there are apparent spills. Ensure these shelving units are cleaned to remove the current build-up of mold/soil accumulation and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.  
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: During the inspection, near the produce prep cooler, there was observed a mop bucket with the mop head stored directly in the basin of the mop bucket. This mop was COS and placed in the top portion of the mop bucket. Ensure the mops are placed in a position that allows for air drying between use. 
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The condenser traps in the meat display coolers are observed to have an accumulation os soil residues. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. Ensure the cleaning takes place during a time when the cooler is clear under the traps so no particles fall onto the food items. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: 
-The bottom of the top door sliding display cooler in the aisle containing meats is observed to have soil on the bottom shelving in multiple locations of the cooler bottom. Ensure these surfaces are clenaed and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
-The freezer aisle displays where the potatoes are kept is observed to have accumulations of debris on the bottom shelves of the freezers. In between stocking these items, ensure to clean the surfaces of these freezer shelves at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The sliding door to the walk-in milk cooler is observed to have bare wood exposed. Ensure a sealant, such as paint, is applied to this surface to make it smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There are observed multiple end of the aisle display cases with an accumulation of soil/dirt/debris. Ensure the floor between the end of aisle displays and the aisle shelves are properly cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of soil/dirt/debris. An additional area needing attention is the gap of the shelving where the root beer is stored, the floor is observed to be very dirty in this gap and will need to be clenaed.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Various shelving units were observed in the dairy area to have an accumulation of soil/mold residue. Between stocking items on the shelves, ensure the shelves are being washed, rinsed, and sanitized at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of the soil/mold residue.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: The mop head in the produce walk-in cooler was observed to be stored inside the basin of the mop bucket. Ensure that the mop head is placed in a way that permits proper air flow to air dry.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

6-501.11: Water accumulation was observed by the farthest on the right produce cooler where the entrance to the prep area and walk-in produce cooler are. The water seems to be leaking form the bottom of the cooler as well as through the floor tiles as they are stepped on beneath the black rug. Ensure proper measures are taken to correct this issue
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

6-501.11:  Water accumulation was observed in the dry storage area along the wall of the meat walk-in cooler. The water seems to be leaking out from under the wood on the floor. A source was not recognized during the time of inspection. Ensure proper maintenance is accomplished to prevent water accumulation in this area.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
